args.missing_evidence: Tube pressure is unmeasurable on this furnace, so absolute pressure/flow-restriction faults can't be excluded directly; low stable O2 plus on-setpoint Ar flow is the available proxy. Post-run characterization (Raman/AFM/optical) is still needed for the scientific question.
